diagnosis.misconceptionText: The student interprets questions asking what a group of blocks is worth altogether as asking for the count of those blocks rather than their total value.
diagnosis.teachingImplication: Contrast the quantity of blocks with their cumulative value by having the student multiply the count of blocks by the value of a single block.
diagnosis.checkNext: Present a set of tens-rods or hundred-flats and ask for their total worth to see if the student continues to report only the number of blocks present.
